name: unsafe fn drop_in_place (self)
rule: While drop_in_place is executing, parts of the value pointed to by self may be accessed only through the &mut self references supplied to the Drop::drop methods invoked by drop_in_place.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * mut T { unsafe fn drop_in_place (self) }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it requires execution-time access tracking and reference identity, neither of which is available.
